scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p prisma/tsconfig.json
scripts.prisma:migrate: node scripts/run-with-root-env.cjs prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-root-env.cjs prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/auth.service.test.ts tests/course.service.test.ts tests/learning.service.test.ts tests/pagination.test.ts tests/error-handler.test.ts tests/validate.middleware.test.ts tests/youtube-url.validator.test.ts tests/course.validator.test.ts
